text:
ana-peopleops: Heads-up — need an expedited comp-band exception + start-date coordination for Priya Kapoor. Manager wants base at 160,000 (band max is 150,000) and a $10k sign-on split. Candidate can start 2026-04-06 due to visa timing. Can we route for fast-track approval?

maria-hiringmgr: She’s our top choice to replace Julio. Early start mattering for project ramp. Manager supports 160k base and 10k sign-on (can split 6k/4k). :pray:

sam-recruiter: Candidate notice is 4w but attorney says H1B transfer earliest work auth 2026-04-05 — so 04-06 start looks feasible. Candidate will be remote in India for ~3 months then relocate. Asking also about when benefits kick in.

dalia-hrbp: Quick policy note — standard benefits effective first of the month after 30 days of service. With 04-06 start they'd be eligible 2026-06-01. If they need earlier coverage we can do a temporary/frontloaded arrangement pending VP People approval.

tony-finance: For base above band max we need comp committee + CFO sign-off. Sign-on can be approved faster. What are the exact offer numbers so I can prep the packet?

ana-peopleops: (updated with offer blob)
```
Offer summary:
- Candidate: Priya Kapoor
- Base: 160000
- Sign-on: 10000 (split 6k/4k)
- Start: 2026-04-06
- Location: Remote (India) -> US relocation ~6mo
- Rationale: exceptional fit, high market comps for this skill set
```
Suggested routing: comp-committee -> VP People (Dalia) -> CFO (Tony) -> final People Ops

offer-bot: Submission received for HR ticket #HR-4591. Expedited flag set. Estimated SLA 3 business days.

tony-finance: Got it. I’ll flag for comp committee on Mon 2026-04-01. If VP People can pre-approve expedited benefits/sign-on we can get CFO to pre-clear quickly. @dalia-hrbp can you mark expedited?

dalia-hrbp: I can approve the benefits workaround and sign-on structure today, but uplift (base > band) needs committee. Marked expedited and added note. Please send market comps, manager note, and candidate CV to comp-committee@redwood.com.

maria-hiringmgr: I’ll add the manager note + market comps now. Sam — can you update the offer letter template to include split sign-on and benefits note?

sam-recruiter: On it. Draft going to gdrive/Offers/Priya_Kapoor_Draft_v1 and CC’ing Legal. If comp committee isn’t back by 2026-04-02, do we proceed with fallback (band max + larger sign-on)? Need confirmation.

ana-peopleops: Fallback plan confirmed by hiring manager: if committee not done by 2026-04-02, offer at band max 150000 + sign-on 15000. Manager agreed to fallback.

maria-hiringmgr: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — will monitor the committee thread and jump in if needed.
thread_summary: Expedited comp-band exception and start-date coordination for candidate Priya Kapoor; team discusses numbers, benefits effective date, visa/work-auth timing, routing for approvals, and fallback offer plan.
